subject: gk
question: Interest received is a factor income from _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Capital**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Capital:**

 
 
• Interest received is a factor income derived from capital.
 
• Capital refers to the financial resources used in production, such as money, machinery, and equipment.
 
• When capital is lent or invested, it generates interest as a return.
 
• Interest is the payment made for the use of borrowed capital.
 
• This is a core concept in economic theory.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Labour:**

 
 
• Labour refers to the human effort used in production.
 
• The factor income derived from labour is wages or salaries.
 
• Labour does not generate interest.
 
• Labour is a very important part of production.
 
• Wages are paid to compensate workers for their time and effort.
 
 
 
• **Land:**
 
 
• Land refers to natural resources used in production, such as soil, minerals, and forests.
 
• The factor income derived from land is rent.
 
• Land itself does not generate interest.
 
• Rent is the payment for the use of land.
 
• Land is a very important part of agriculture.
 
 
 
• **Entrepreneurship:**
 
 
• Entrepreneurship refers to the organizational and risk-taking ability used in production.
 
• The factor income derived from entrepreneurship is profit.
 
• Entrepreneurs do not receive interest as a direct factor income.
 
• Profit is the compensation for the risk that the entrepreneur takes.
 
• Entrepreneurs are very important for economic growth.
